```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position and team per player-season (a handful of ids repeat).
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position,
          any_value(team) AS team
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team)) |> label_endings()
study_pop <- filter(endings, group != "Position not recorded")
state_fill <- ending_palette()
state_lab <- c(ending_labels(), playing = "Still playing")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
never <- never_eligible_entrants(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team))
n_roster <- n_distinct(outcomes$playerId)
n_players <- nrow(endings)
n_never <- nrow(never)
n_no_pos <- sum(endings$group == "Position not recorded")
n_awaiting <- sum(study_pop$time == 0)
step <- 3
trunk_x <- -1.9
flow_main <- tibble(
  label = c("Players on a college roster", "Draft-eligible", "Study population"),
  n = c(n_roster, n_players, nrow(study_pop)),
  y = c(4.65, 3, 2) * step
) |>
  mutate(
    share = n / lag(n),
    box = if_else(
      is.na(share),
      sprintf("%s\n%s", label, fmt(n)),
      sprintf("%s\n%s (%s)", label, fmt(n), pct(share))
    )
  )
flow_side <- tibble(
  label = c(
    sprintf("Never draft-eligible\n%s (%s)", fmt(n_roster - n_players - n_never), pct((n_roster - n_players - n_never) / n_roster)),
    sprintf("Ruled out: reached the NFL\nbefore he could be eligible\n%s (%s)", fmt(n_never), pct(n_never / n_roster)),
    sprintf("Position not recorded\n%s (%s)", fmt(n_no_pos), pct(n_no_pos / n_players))
  ),
  y = c(4.65 * step - 1.3, 4.65 * step - 3.4, 3 * step - 1.5)
)
flow_end <- study_pop |>
  mutate(state = if_else(ending == "censored", "playing", ending)) |>
  count(state) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    share = n / nrow(study_pop)
  ) |>
  arrange(label) |>
  mutate(
    x = seq(-3.6, 3.6, length.out = n()),
    box = sprintf("%s\n%s (%s)", sub(", ", ",\n", label), fmt(n), pct(share)),
    text_colour = if_else(state %in% c("left_data", "playing"), "#111827", "#FFFFFF")
  )
h <- 0.5
bar_y <- min(flow_main$y) - 1.1
end_y <- bar_y - 1.25
side_x <- 0.1

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = tibble(y = head(flow_main$y, -1), yend = tail(flow_main$y, -1)),
    aes(x = trunk_x, xend = trunk_x, y = y - h, yend = yend + h),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = flow_side,
    aes(x = trunk_x, xend = side_x - 0.05, y = y, yend = y),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = trunk_x, xend = trunk_x, y = min(flow_main$y) - h, yend = bar_y, colour = "#4B5563", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x = min(flow_end$x), xend = max(flow_end$x), y = bar_y, yend = bar_y, colour = "#4B5563", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
    data = flow_end,
    aes(x = x, xend = x, y = bar_y, yend = end_y + h),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    colour = "#4B5563",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_main,
    aes(trunk_x, y, label = box),
    size = 6,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = "#FFFFFF",
    colour = "#111827",
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_side,
    aes(side_x, y, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    fill = "#F3F4F6",
    colour = "#374151",
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = flow_end,
    aes(x, end_y + h, label = box, fill = label, colour = text_colour),
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-4.6, 4.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(end_y - 1.2, max(flow_main$y) + 0.6)) +
  labs(
    title = "From every roster player to the study population",
    subtitle = "Each box is a count of players and its percent of the box above it",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

card_thumbnail(p, "career-study-population", release = release, height = 6.5)
card_interactive(p, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: when-careers-end
season_counts <- study_pop |>
  mutate(group = droplevels(group), state = if_else(ending == "censored", "playing", ending)) |>
  count(group, state, time) |>
  tidyr::complete(group, state, time = 0:max(endings$time), fill = list(n = 0L)) |>
  filter(state == "playing" | time > 0) |>
  mutate(label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)), share = n / sum(n), .by = "group") |>
  filter(sum(n) > 0, .by = "state")
position_colour <- c("#1F77B4", "#FF7F0E", "#2CA02C", "#D62728", "#9467BD", "#8C564B", "#E377C2", "#17BECF", "#BCBD22")
p_when <- season_counts |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, eligible season %d: %s %s (%s of the group)",
      group,
      time,
      fmt(n),
      if_else(
        state == "playing",
        if_else(time == 0, "still playing, awaiting their first draft", "still playing, counted through this season"),
        tolower(label)
      ),
      pct(share)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, n, colour = group)) +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = group), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = group), size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(18)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = position_colour) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:max(season_counts$time)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "When careers end, ending by ending",
    subtitle = "Players by the eligible season their career ended in; still playing is counted at his last season observed",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Players",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Each panel has its own scale. Hover a line to follow one group across the endings."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
card_interactive(p_when, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: examples
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who               , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Jordan Travis"    , "4360799"       ,
  "Shane Buechele"   , "4039034"       ,
  "Zane Zandier"     , "4240855"       ,
  "Grant Calcaterra" , "4241374"
)
last_team <- outcomes |>
  summarise(last = max(season), .by = "playerId") |>
  left_join(select(roster_pos, playerId, season, team), by = c("playerId", "last" = "season"))
ending_lab <- ending_labels()
subjects |>
  inner_join(endings, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  left_join(last_team, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  mutate(
    url = explorer_player_url(cfb_athlete_id, as.character(group)),
    who = if_else(is.na(url), who, sprintf("[%s](%s)", who, url)),
    how = if_else(ending == "drafted", sprintf("Drafted, round %d", round), unname(ending_lab[ending])),
    hs = if_else(hs_year_imputed, "Estimated", "From recruiting"),
    missed = if_else(missed_season, "Yes", "No")
  ) |>
  arrange(match(ending, names(ending_lab)), desc(missed_season)) |>
  transmute(who, group = as.character(group), team, how, time, hs, missed) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Position", "Last team", "How it ended", "In eligible season", "High-school year", "Missed a season"),
    caption = "Example players, one per ending plus a missed season, computed from the data. Names link to the Explorer. The figures describe groups, not any one player's chances."
  )
```
